description: This file defines the GlossaryController class within the Goteo project's MVC architecture. It handles the display of glossary terms, manages pagination, and renders the glossary index view.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\GlossaryController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the glossary index page, including fetching all glossary terms, handling pagination, and rendering the view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting database caching and replica options.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the request to display the glossary index, processes glossary terms for display, manages pagination, and renders the output.
